questions.question: What is the primary role of CSS media queries in modern web engineering?
options: To play audio and video files
To conditionally apply CSS rules based on device characteristics like screen width and orientation
To query SQL databases from CSS
To compress HTML code on the fly
questions.hint: Responsive design adaptation based on device characteristics.
questions.explanation: Media queries inspect screen size, resolution, and orientation to apply targeted responsive styles.

questions.question: Which media query condition matches devices with a screen width of 768 pixels or wider?
questions.explanation: (min-width: 768px) triggers when the viewport width is equal to or greater than 768px.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the comma operator in @media (max-width: 600px), (orientation: portrait)?
questions.explanation: In media queries, a comma acts as a logical OR: the block applies if either query evaluates to true.

questions.question: Which media type specifically targets physical printed paper copies of a webpage?
questions.explanation: @media print allows developers to format pages for physical printing (hiding navigation, headers, and ads).

questions.question: What modern CSS range syntax is equivalent to @media (min-width: 600px) and (max-width: 900px)?
questions.explanation: Modern CSS Media Queries Level 4 supports mathematical comparison operators: @media (600px <= width <= 900px).
